failure_stage: PowerShell logging wrapper after the final 2024 archive verification
exception: CommandNotFoundException: the token 2>&1 was placed after a completed script block and parsed as a command
impact: The enclosing shell returned exit code 1 after all 84 monthly archives and seven create-only manifests had already been downloaded, validated, hashed, and written. No archive or manifest write failed.

independent_validation.checks: all manifest self-hashes, exactly 12 months per year, every local archive present, and every recorded archive SHA-256 matched

disposition: Preserve the nonzero wrapper outcome and log. Accept the archives only through the independent validation and the downstream census normalizer's repeated hash checks. Correct logging syntax in future launchers.
